changesApplied.changeMade: Fixed regex pattern to correctly extract reportExecution function without capturing adjacent functions. Removed duplicate test case.
changesApplied.reason: The previous regex was too greedy and captured the callMCPTool helper function definition, causing false positives. The new implementation uses brace-counting to precisely extract the function body.
